description: roundRect(): the radius upstream clips rounded images and frames with, filled and stroked, zero, large enough to be scaled down, on negative widths and heights, and a negative radius that draws nothing
toleranceNote: Every draw goes through ports of Chrome's own pipeline (Skia's analytic anti-aliasing, edge builder and clipper, stroker, dasher and AntiFillRect, Blink's arc handling), so what remains is rounding in blending, coverage and sampling: against Chrome 153 no pixel here is more than 3 levels off. 8 leaves room for another Chrome build that rounds differently.
